title: Key Lime Pie Ice Pops
changes_from_base: A no-cook key lime pie mix of milk, condensed milk, cream cheese and lime replaces the strawberry purée, with broken Marie biscuits soaked in each pop.
summary: A key lime pie in ice pop form, with a tangy lime and cream cheese filling studded with crushed biscuit.
equipment: 10 ice-pop bags (boli bags) or ten 120 ml moulds and sticks

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

ingredients.note: 4 for the blender, 30 broken by hand

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Blend 395 ml whole milk, 397 g condensed milk, 190 g cream cheese, 160 g caster sugar, ½ tsp vanilla and a pinch of salt until smooth, about 15 s, then add 120 ml key lime juice and blend for 10 s more.

steps.title: Crumb
steps.text: Add the lime zest and 4 of the Marie biscuits and pulse twice to coarse crumbs.

steps.title: Layer
steps.text: Break 3 biscuits by hand into each of 10 ice-pop bags or moulds.

steps.title: Pour
steps.text: Pour about 115 g of the mixture into each bag, squeeze gently to soak the biscuits, then tie the bags leaving room to expand (or fill the moulds).

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Snip off a bottom corner of each bag, or unmould, and eat at once.

tips: Soften the cream cheese slightly before blending so it mixes in without lumps.
Squeeze the bags gently so the biscuit pieces soak through evenly.
Serve these straight from the freezer, as they soften quickly once unwrapped.
storage: Keep the pops in their bags or moulds in the freezer.
